outreach.subject: Kubernetes cost discipline at Salesforce's scale
outreach.body:
Hi Marcus Williams,

I'm Prashant Biswas from Ganit. We are a full-stack Data & AI company, recognized by Everest, Forrester, and Analytics India.

With Salesforce running a massive multi-tenant platform on AWS and Kubernetes while your San Francisco engineering org is in a headcount consolidation phase (down ~4% over the last year), I'd imagine the pressure on your infrastructure team to do more with less — without compromising platform reliability for 150,000+ customers — is very real right now.

We help platform and infra teams at enterprise scale reduce Kubernetes and cloud spend while cutting incident response toil — so your engineers spend less time firefighting and more time shipping.

As an AWS Advanced Tier Partner with 6+ years of partnership, we've built integrated cloud infrastructure for companies running Salesforce as a core source system, so we understand the complexity of your stack firsthand.

Would a focused 20-minute call next week be worth it to compare notes on where Salesforce-scale teams are finding the most leverage on cloud cost and observability?

With regards,
Ganit team
